name: console/scripts-list
address: scripts?item=<a deployed script that was never run>
setup: handbook, plus a script made in the console from the Greet someone starter and deployed in Fernhill's Sandbox workspace
ready: the inspector of the chosen script shows Open editor, Run and Offer to an agent…
steps: choose the row of the console script
alt: The Scripts list with the Show chips All, Failing, Never run and Drafted above a table of scripts, and the inspector of the chosen script showing its timeout, retries and what it uses, with Open editor, Run and Offer to an agent buttons.

name: console/script-settings-tab
setup: the same console script, deployed, with a draft that sets Give up after to 90 seconds and Try again to 2 times
ready: the Settings tab shows Stops after and Tries again, and the draft notice
alt: A script's page on its Settings tab: a notice that the script has a draft, the list Stops after 90 seconds and Tries again 2 times, and a Change the settings button.

name: console/script-editor
setup: the same console script, deployed with no draft
ready: the code editor and the test pane are drawn
alt: The script editor: the header with the Deployed pill and the Offer to an agent, Name and path, Remove, Save draft and Deploy buttons, the Settings disclosure, the code on the left and the test pane with its input form on the right.

name: console/scripts-test-pane
setup: the same console script; the test run of the draft with the name Rowan is done
ready: the Result tab shows Succeeded and one log line
mask: the run's wait and run times
alt: The script editor with the code on the left and the test pane on the right showing a Succeeded run, its one log line and the Result, Problems and Runs tabs.

name: console/scripts-offer-done
setup: the same console script, deployed; the tenant has a service account
ready: the dialog shows Address for the agent and Copy the address
mask: the address's tenant and workspace IDs
alt: The Offer to an agent dialog after Offer was pressed: a confirmation that the service account may now run the script and nothing else, the address for the agent with a Copy the address button, and a link to the account's keys and tools.
